article_body:
Basketball can change pace with one possession. Players adjust, defenders rotate and the reactions of teammates offer another way to understand the action.

Photographed by Mason Bybee, this collection brings a courtside perspective to St. Vincent–St. Mary against St. Edward. It is a visual feature, not a claim about an unverified final score.
